en: The highest recorded temperature in the Philippines was 53.1 degrees Celsius in Tuguegarao, Cagayan, on May 11, 1969.
Clay soil particles are smaller than 0.002 millimeters, while sand particles are much larger, ranging from 0.05 to 2.0 millimeters.
Talc is the softest mineral with a Mohs hardness of 1, while diamond is the hardest with a rating of 10.
Oceans hold about 97 percent of all Earth's water, while glaciers and ice caps hold most of the remaining 3 percent.
Jupiter is so massive that more than 1,300 Earths could fit inside its volume, making it the largest planet.
Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes to reach Earth, but light from Proxima Centauri takes over four years.
The Moon's gravity is only one-sixth of Earth's gravity, so a 60-kilogram person would weigh just 10 kilograms there.
Super Typhoon Haiyan in 2013 had maximum sustained winds of 315 kilometers per hour, making it one of the strongest cyclones recorded.
Venus is the hottest planet in our solar system with a surface temperature of 465 degrees Celsius, even hotter than Mercury.
The Moon's diameter is about 3,474 kilometers, which is roughly one-quarter the size of Earth's 12,742-kilometer diameter.
Pumice is a volcanic rock with a density of less than 1 gram per cubic centimeter, allowing it to float on water.
The Pacific Ocean covers about 165 million square kilometers, which is larger than all of Earth's landmasses combined.
